data.title: Coda greets the human in kadence init
data.description: The owner chose a character for kadence on 2026-10-10: Coda, a notehead with an eighth-note crest (flat SVG on the site, a pixel twin in the terminal). In the product it appears only where a person reads: kadence init's success message on a TTY. Never in --json, prime, hooks or any output an agent reads — it would cost tokens and change a contract.
